component.name: GazBoard
component.summary: Offline whiteboard with Word, PowerPoint and PDF import

description.p: A free-form digital whiteboard that runs entirely on your own computer. There is no account, no sign-in and no cloud: your boards stay on your machine.
It is an offline rebuild of the classic Microsoft Whiteboard 21.x experience, with one addition: Word, PowerPoint and PDF files come onto the board as pages you can write straight on top of.

ul.li: Pens, a highlighter and pressure-sensitive ink that stays exactly as you drew it
Sticky notes, shapes, text, images, emoji and a ruler
A teaching kit: full-screen presenting, answer covers you tap to reveal, and a class timer
Export to PNG, SVG and PDF
Available in English, Bangla, Chinese, Arabic, Spanish and Portuguese
Send a board to another computer on the same network, with no internet needed

screenshot.caption: Six pens, a highlighter, and pressure-sensitive ink with no smoothing
Annotating a lecture slide imported from PowerPoint
Sticky notes for structuring a semester plan
Importing selected pages from a PowerPoint deck
Exporting a board as a PDF
